headline: Indian bond yields rise as oil prices surge and inflation concerns persist
summary: Indian government bond yields climbed as Brent crude prices exceeded $95 per barrel and the central bank highlighted broad-based food inflation pressures.
why: Rising oil prices increase import costs for India, potentially fueling inflation and forcing tighter monetary policy.

impacts.name: Indian 10-year bond yield
impacts.why: Inflationary pressures and higher energy costs typically lead to higher bond yields as investors demand more compensation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher oil prices and inflation expectations directly impact the sovereign debt market by increasing yield requirements.
